detect_agent: detect the AI coding agent by checking environment variables and return its name
is_agent: check if the current process is being invoked by an AI coding agent
detect_claude_code: detect claude-code agent by setting the CLAUDE_CODE environment variable
detect_cursor: detect cursor editor agent by setting the CURSOR_TRACE_ID environment variable
detect_github_copilot: detect github-copilot agent by setting the COPILOT_MODEL environment variable
